import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static char[][] s1 = new char[15][15];
    static char[][] s2 = new char[15][15];
    static int[][] dir = {{-1, 0}, {1, 0}, {0, -1}, {0, 1}};
    static int[][][] idx = new int[65][15][15];
    static int[][] dp = new int[15][15];
    static int id = 1;

    static class Edge {
        int u, v;
        long cap, flow;

        Edge() {}

        Edge(int u, int v, long cap) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        int N;
        List<Edge> E;
        List<List<Integer>> g;
        int[] d;
        int[] pt;

        Dinic(int N) {
            this.N = N;
            this.E = new ArrayList<>();
            this.g = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            this.d = new int[N];
            this.pt = new int[N];
        }

        void AddEdge(int u, int v, long cap) {
            if (u != v) {
                E.add(new Edge(u, v, cap));
                g.get(u).add(E.size() - 1);
                E.add(new Edge(v, u, 0));
                g.get(v).add(E.size() - 1);
            }
        }

        boolean BFS(int S, int T) {
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(S);
            Arrays.fill(d, N + 1);
            d[S] = 0;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                if (u == T) break;
                for (int k : g.get(u)) {
                    Edge e = E.get(k);
                    if (e.flow < e.cap && d[e.v] > d[e.u] + 1) {
                        d[e.v] = d[e.u] + 1;
                        q.add(e.v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return d[T] != N + 1;
        }

        long DFS(int u, int T, long flow) {
            if (u == T || flow == 0) return flow;
            for (int i = pt[u]; i < g.get(u).size(); i++) {
                pt[u] = i;
                Edge e = E.get(g.get(u).get(i));
                Edge oe = E.get(g.get(u).get(i) ^ 1);
                if (d[e.v] == d[e.u] + 1) {
                    long amt = e.cap - e.flow;
                    if (flow != -1 && amt > flow) amt = flow;
                    long pushed = DFS(e.v, T, amt);
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.flow += pushed;
                        oe.flow -= pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long MaxFlow(int S, int T) {
            long total = 0;
            while (BFS(S, T)) {
                Arrays.fill(pt, 0);
                while (true) {
                    long flow = DFS(S, T, -1);
                    if (flow <= 0) break;
                    total += flow;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dp[i], -1);
        }
        
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                s1[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= t + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                    idx[i][j][k] = id++;
                }
            }
        }
        id++;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                s2[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }
        
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (s1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    q.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    dp[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int uy = cell[0], ux = cell[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int vy = uy + dir[i][0], vx = ux + dir[i][1];
                if (vy >= 1 && vy <= n && vx >= 1 && vx <= n && s1[vy][vx] != 'Y' && dp[vy][vx] == -1) {
                    dp[vy][vx] = dp[uy][ux] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{vy, vx});
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (dp[i][j] == -1) dp[i][j] = (int) 1e9;
                if (dp[i][j] > t) dp[i][j] = (int) 1e9;
            }
        }
        
        int source = 0, sink = id - 1;
        Dinic dinic = new Dinic(id);
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (s1[i][j] >= '1' && s1[i][j] <= '9') {
                    dinic.AddEdge(source, idx[0][i][j], s1[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (s1[i][j] == 'Y' || s1[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                    int vy = i + dir[k][0], vx = j + dir[k][1];
                    if (vy >= 1 && vy <= n && vx >= 1 && vx <= n && s1[vy][vx] != 'Y' && s1[vy][vx] != 'Z') {
                        for (int x = 0; x < t; x++) {
                            if (dp[vy][vx] >= x + 1 && dp[i][j] > x) {
                                dinic.AddEdge(idx[x][i][j], idx[x + 1][vy][vx], 1000);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (s1[i][j] == 'Y' || s1[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                for (int x = 0; x <= t; x++) {
                    if (s2[i][j] >= '1' && s2[i][j] <= '9') {
                        dinic.AddEdge(idx[x][i][j], idx[t + 1][i][j], s2[i][j] - '0');
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (s1[i][j] == 'Y' || s1[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                if (s2[i][j] >= '1' && s2[i][j] <= '9') {
                    dinic.AddEdge(idx[t + 1][i][j], sink, s2[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(dinic.MaxFlow(source, sink));
    }
}
